body:
## Code Review

This pull request adds three detailed markdown reports to the `docs/reports/` directory: a V1 data statistics report, a root cause audit of local data governance failures, and a phased hybrid VLM remediation plan, as well as updating the reports index. The review comments are highly actionable, pointing out an incorrect relative path in the remediation plan and a markdown formatting violation in the audit report. Both comments should be addressed to ensure documentation accuracy and consistency.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
